slow_fire.question: Why did the fire spread at about a sixth of the standard rate between 12:17 and 2:49 p.m.?

H0.hypothesis: Not really slow: a measurement artefact

H1b.hypothesis: Indirect containment: guards or roads at the boundary of permanent danger area 2

H2.hypothesis: Patchy ground at 10 m scale or larger (bare ground, old burns, gaps)

H2b.hypothesis: Fine-scale fuel reduction below 10 m (grazing, trampling, cratering, short grass)

H3.hypothesis: Grass not fully cured (still partly green)

H4.hypothesis: Damper fine fuel and lighter wind at grass height than the station implies

timeline_location.question: Where was the pairs range, and when was it overtaken?

L1.hypothesis: Range 2 / road head area, overtaken about 3:20-3:35 ('just before 4:00' approximate)

L2.hypothesis: Further south-east, 2-3 km from the fire at the shift, overtaken about 3:40-3:55 ('about a kilometre' approximate)

L3.hypothesis: On the fire's flank (strip south-east of the road head or by the western lake): both statements literal

L4.hypothesis: The front reached the fire much later than the station (about 3:45), so Range 2 burned just before 4:00
